question: Which volume of the 'Akbar-Nama' is known as Ain-i-Akbari and deals with Akbar's administration, household, army and revenues and geography of his empire?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Third**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Akbar-Nama** is a historical account written by **Abu'l-Fazl**, one of the Navratnas of Emperor Akbar's court.
 
• It consists of three volumes, of which the **third volume** is known as the **Ain-i-Akbari**.
 
• The Ain-i-Akbari is an administrative document that provides detailed information about **Akbar's governance**, including his **administration, household, army, revenue system, and the geography of his empire**.
 
• This volume is divided into five books, each covering distinct aspects of Akbar's reign:
 
 
• **Book One:** Deals with the imperial household and administration.
 
• **Book Two:** Discusses the army, weapons, and military organization.
 
• **Book Three:** Covers Akbar's revenue system and land measurements.
 
• **Book Four:** Includes information about the culture, arts, and sciences.
 
• **Book Five:** Contains a biography of the author and miscellaneous topics.
 
 
 
• The Ain-i-Akbari is regarded as a remarkable source of information about the functioning of the **Mughal Empire** under Akbar's rule.
 
• The text reflects Akbar's policies of cultural integration, administrative efficiency, and his interest in compiling detailed information about his empire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Second Volume**__

 __
 
• The second volume of the Akbar-Nama provides a detailed account of Akbar's reign, including his wars, campaigns, and administrative reforms.
 
• It primarily focuses on the historical narrative of the events during Akbar's rule.
 
 
 
• **Fourth Volume**__
 __
 
• There is no fourth volume in the Akbar-Nama, as it consists of only three volumes. This option is incorrect.
 
 
 
• **Fifth Volume**__
 
 
• Similar to the fourth volume, the Akbar-Nama does not have a fifth volume. Hence, this option is invalid.
